name: Bludgeoning - [MMMM]
description:
Ah, is there any sound more dissonant than the crunch of a
broken bone? Few types of dano are more efficient at
taking your limbs out of commission than Bludgeoning. Do
not forget to assess your patient's noggin, though. An errant
club swing can result in a nasty concussion or a ruptured
eardrum. Most often, though, Bludgeoning leaves you with the
colorful parting gift of a black eye or a broken nose. Not the
prettiest accessories for polite company.

results.description:
A violent impact to the side of your head has caused your right eardrum to rupture. Your right ear is não funcional. If it is not treated dentro de 24 horas, your hearing in this ear is permanently ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Save Sense Surgery
results.name: Ruptured Right Eardrum

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Large membro Table (Tabela de Membros Maiores)}. The enormous impact of the blow has caused seu membro to be torn from its socket. O membro is ausente and thrown 15 feet in a random direction.

Tratamento - A DC 22 Save membro Surgery
results.name: membro Torn Asunder

results.description:
A blow to your face has knocked one of your teeth clean out of your mouth.

Tratamento - A [[/skill perception 15]] check will allow you to recover the tooth. A DC 19 General Surgery dentro de 1 day of the injury occurring allows you to reinsert the tooth.
results.name: Lost Tooth

results.description:
A mighty strike to your head has left you with dizziness, nausea, and a lingering headache. Any time you make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma Saving Throw Você está also &Reference[stunned]{stunned} até the end of your next Turno. This condition lasts [[1d12]] dias.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d8]] dias.
results.name: Concussion

results.description: You gasp for breath as the blow knocks you flat onto your back. Você está &Reference[prone]{prone} and you lose concentration.
results.name: Wind Knocked out of You

results.description:
The Force of the impact jars your nerves and sends a spreading numbness through your left arm. You drop anything Você está holding with that arm and it is não funcional for [[1d4]] Turnos.

Tratamento - Any amount of magical cura will end this effect.
results.name: Numb Left Arm

results.description:
You feel a sharp pain as the blow lands directly on one of your extremities. Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Small apêndice Table (Tabela de Apêndices Menores)}. That apêndice is broken and não funcional for [[1d12]] dias.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 12]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d10]] dias.
results.name: Broken apêndice

results.description:
Roll to randomly determine the left or right arm. The intensity of the blow has forced your shoulder joint from its socket. This arm is não funcional.

Tratamento - While on initiative, make a [[/check con 18]] check as a bonus action to Force the joint into place and end this injury. Off initiative, a [[/skill medicine 18]] check will end this injury.
results.name: Dislocated Shoulder

results.description: You've got yourself a good ol' fashioned shiner. It will resolve on its own in [[1d6]] dias, but you may look out of place in polite company até then.
results.name: Black Eye

results.description:
A sharp impact to your face has left you with a painfully broken nose.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 8]] check will set your nose properly, otherwise it has a 50% chance of cura slightly crooked in [[1d6]] dias. The DC of this check increases by 2 each time your nose is broken.
results.name: Broken Nose

results.description:
The Force of the impact jars your nerves and sends a spreading numbness through your right arm. You drop anything Você está holding with that arm and it is não funcional for [[1d4]] Turnos.

Tratamento - Any amount of magical cura will end this effect.
results.name: Numb Right Arm

results.description: Your entire body aches and Você está left with some extensive ugly bruises. Any time you make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check you take Bludgeoning dano scaled to the dano that caused the lesão persistente: 1-10 dano ([[1d4]]), 11-20 dano ([[1d6]]), 21-30 dano ([[1d8]]), 31-40 dano ([[1d10]]), >40 dano ([[1d12]]). This injury resolves on its own in [[1d4]] dias.
results.name: Bruised Black and Blue

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. The ache of your injury never completely leaves you and even years later you sometimes feel a twinge of pain. The bones in/around the area rolled ache 6 horas before (roll [[1d6]]): 1) Rain, 2) Bright Sunshine, 3) Snow, 4) Fog, 5) Storms, 6) Calamities and Natural Disasters
results.name: Aching Bones

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Large membro Table (Tabela de Membros Maiores)}. This membro is broken and não funcional for [[1d12]] dias.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d8]] dias.
results.name: Broken membro

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Large membro Table (Tabela de Membros Maiores)}. seu membro is crushed to the point of uselessness and permanently não funcional. If it isn't reconstructed, O membro will not regain functionality.

Tratamento - A DC 23 Save membro Surgery
results.name: Crushed membro
